turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hey, how's your day been so far?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'm planning a photo walk this weekend and can't pick where to go.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Wait until I've listed everything before you jump in.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: One option is the old downtown market early in the morning, when vendors are setting up.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Another is the botanical garden, which has a big flower show going on right now.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Or there's the harbor at sunset, with the boats and the bridge lit up.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, I'm done. What do you think?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: What kind of photos do you enjoy taking most, people, nature or landscapes? If it's people, the morning market is the best fit. You could even do the market and then the harbor later the same day.
